About.metaDescription: Why we built Vercilio: a better home for every AI model, with real-world environmental impact built in.
About.heroBody: We started Vercilio because we kept paying for AI tools that felt loud, lonely, and hungry for our data — and gave nothing back to the world the conversations were about.
About.storyParagraph1: Most subscription apps treat you like a meter. The dashboards scream, the upgrade prompts pulse, and the moment you forget to cancel, the bill arrives twice. We wanted something that felt the opposite — a tool you could leave open in a tab and never resent.
About.storyParagraph2: So Vercilio is built around a small set of beliefs: that frontier models should live next to fast, cheap ones in the same window; that monthly credits beat token math; that a focused interface is worth more than a clever one; and that the planet doing the heating of these GPUs deserves a kickback every month.
About.storyParagraph3: What you pay for is the access and the simplicity. What we keep is a modest margin on each plan. The remainder goes to mangrove restoration in Brazil and Kenya and native-tree planting across North America through long-term partner programs. You see the receipts in your settings.

difference.question: How is this different from paying for another AI subscription?
difference.answer: The core idea is simple: if you're already paying monthly for AI, Vercilio gives you one home for the best models and uses paid activity to fund environmental work through our partners at the same time.

models.question: Do all paid plans include the same models?
models.answer: Yes. Every paid plan includes the same paid conversational model catalog. You are not upgrading for a different set of models. You are upgrading for more credits, more daily room, and more impact.

free.question: What does the free plan include?
free.answer: Free gives you a smaller monthly credit balance and access to a lighter set of models, so you can learn the product before deciding whether it fits your workflow.

uploads.question: Can I upload documents and images?
uploads.answer: Yes. File reading, image understanding, and web search are part of the product. Compatible models can work with PDFs, screenshots, photos, and other common inputs directly in chat.

contribution.question: What exactly is the environmental contribution?
contribution.answer: Paid subscriptions fund verified tree planting through our partners. Higher plans plant more each month.

addons.question: Can I buy more credits without changing plans?
addons.answer: Yes. You can top up with one-time credit add-ons whenever you need more room for a busy month.

rollover.question: Do unused credits roll over forever?
rollover.answer: Monthly plan credits refresh each cycle. One-time purchased add-ons stay available while your account remains active.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes. You can manage your subscription from billing and make changes when your usage changes.

create: Draft a cold outreach email that doesn't feel like a cold outreach email.
Write a one-page bedtime story a 6-year-old will ask to hear twice.
Help me name a side project — give me 10 options with the reasoning.
Turn my rough notes into a tight LinkedIn post. Ask me for the notes first.
explore: What's a non-obvious habit that quietly compounds over a decade?
Compare living in Lisbon, Mexico City, and Bali for a remote worker.
Explain why some countries are rich and others aren't — without oversimplifying.
Give me three contrarian takes on AI that smart people actually hold.
code: Review this function and tell me what a senior engineer would change. I'll paste it.

Walk me through setting up auth in a Next.js app, with the trade-offs of each option.
I'm getting a flaky test. Ask me what I know and help me diagnose it.

Walk me through what actually happens when I type a URL and hit enter.

Models.metaDescription: Every chat model worth using, in one workspace: GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, and more. Routed and ready, with credit pricing that doesn't depend on token math.
Models.heroBody: Vercilio routes across the world's leading conversational AI providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, xAI, DeepSeek, Mistral, and more — so you can move between frontier reasoning and fast everyday work in the same window.
Models.providersBody: We follow new releases as they ship. Every model below is currently available in chat to subscribers, with appropriate guardrails for vision, file reading, and web search where supported.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.body: The full GPT lineup — fast minis for everyday questions, balanced 4o-class models, and frontier GPT-5 for reasoning that benefits from a wider window.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.body: Claude Haiku for quick rewrites, Claude Sonnet as a dependable default, and Claude Opus when the answer needs careful, long-form thinking.

google.name: Google
google.body: Gemini Flash for speed, Gemini Pro for harder questions, and Gemini Pro Preview for the very latest from DeepMind — multimodal-native and search-aware.

meta.name: Meta
meta.body: Llama models for open-weight workflows when you want a model that runs the same way many teams already self-host.

xai.name: xAI
xai.body: Grok for a different point of view, with strengths in current events and casual conversational tone.

deepseek.name: DeepSeek
deepseek.body: DeepSeek's frontier-quality reasoning models at noticeably lower cost — useful for long analysis sessions without watching the meter.

mistral.name: Mistral
mistral.body: Mistral and Magistral covers strong European-trained models — fast, multilingual, and tuned for production code and writing tasks.

cohere.name: Cohere
cohere.body: Command models built for retrieval and enterprise workflows, with a focus on multilingual document work.

perplexity.name: Perplexity
perplexity.body: Search-grounded Sonar models when the answer should come with citations from the live web.

Models.categoriesTitle: Pick by job, not by name
Models.categoriesBody: Names change every quarter. The categories below stay the same — pick the one that matches the work, and the picker filters down.

fast.title: Fast & affordable
fast.body: Short answers, quick rewrites, format conversions, and everyday Q&A. Lowest per-message cost; great for high-volume work and free-plan use.

balanced.title: Balanced default
balanced.body: The models you'd reach for without thinking — strong quality, fair latency, sensible cost. This is where most paid traffic goes.

advanced.title: Advanced reasoning
advanced.body: Multi-step problems, deeper analysis, long context. Higher per-message cost, noticeably better answers on harder questions.

frontier.title: Frontier
frontier.body: The latest releases from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. Use when an answer needs to be as good as today's best general-purpose AI can produce.

Models.featuresTitle: Everything chat-models can do, in one place

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: Drop in a screenshot, photo, diagram, or whiteboard shot. Vision-capable models read images directly inside the conversation.

files.title: Files
files.body: Attach PDFs and other documents. The model parses them inline — no separate uploader, no chunking dance.

search.title: Web search
search.body: Toggle search and the model answers with live citations. We surface the sources beneath every reply.

reasoning.title: Reasoning effort
reasoning.body: On reasoning-capable models you can choose Low, Medium, or High. Higher effort means longer thinking and better answers on hard tasks.

auto.title: Auto-router
auto.body: Let Vercilio pick the right model for each message. The router uses OpenRouter's live evaluations to send you the best fit per turn.

tools.title: Tool use
tools.body: Compatible models can call tools when needed. Currently used for web search; agentic workflows are on the roadmap.

Models.ctaTitle: Start free. Upgrade for the heavier models.
Models.ctaBody: The free plan ships with 100 credits a month on the small-tier models — perfect for learning the product. Upgrade to a paid plan when you want frontier reasoning, vision, web search, and the monthly environmental contribution.

Impact.heroBody: Vercilio keeps a small, fixed margin on every plan. The remainder is routed to long-term restoration partners on three continents. You see exactly what your subscription has funded inside your account.

Impact.partnersBody: We don't run the planting. We fund and report on the work of partners with verifiable on-the-ground programs.

mangrove.title: Mangrove restoration
mangrove.body: Coastal mangrove regeneration with community planting teams. Mangroves protect shorelines, build biodiversity, and store carbon faster than most upland forests.

arbor.title: Native forest planting
arbor.body: Native-species reforestation across the United States and Canada, in partnership with long-running forestry programs that track species diversity and survival.

Impact.howTitle: How a payment becomes a tree
Impact.howBody: Behind every subscription is a clean, auditable path from card charge to planted unit.

step1.title: You subscribe
step1.body: A successful Stripe payment lands. Your plan upgrades and your monthly credits land instantly.

step2.title: A contribution event is recorded
step2.body: Vercilio records the per-payment contribution and converts it into specific planting units (e.g. 12 mangrove + 3 native trees for the Starter plan).

step3.title: Trees are planted by partners
step3.body: Within the next planting window, partner field teams plant the corresponding units. Each contribution is logged against your account.

step4.title: You can see the receipts
step4.body: Your contribution dashboard shows every event, the trees attributed to your account, and the running community total.

noOffset.title: This isn't a carbon offset
noOffset.body: We do not sell carbon credits and we do not claim that using AI is carbon-neutral. We fund tree planting because it's good work — not as a balance sheet.

noFarmed.title: Real planting, not certificates
noFarmed.body: The contribution converts into actual planted units through partners with field operations. We do not buy generic offset certificates from an exchange.

noStatistics.title: We don't inflate the numbers
noStatistics.body: The aggregate counts you see come from partner reporting. We round down when we round, not up.

Impact.ctaTitle: Subscribe. Plant trees. Use better AI.
Impact.ctaBody: Pick a plan. Use the best chat models in one place. Watch the trees stack up inside your account, month after month.

LegalTerms.heroBody: These terms govern your use of Vercilio. By creating an account or paying for a subscription you accept them. If you don't agree, please stop using the service.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: Vercilio is an AI workspace that lets you chat with leading conversational AI models and routes a share of every paid subscription to verified reforestation partners. We refer to the service throughout these terms as "Vercilio", "we", "us", or "the service". You — the account holder — are referred to as "you".
Vercilio is operated by the entity registered in France. Our principal contact for legal matters is legal@vercilio.ai.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility
paragraphs: You must be at least 16 years old to create a Vercilio account (or the age of digital consent in your country, whichever is higher). The service is not designed for children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect data from them.
If you are creating an account on behalf of a company, you confirm that you have the authority to bind that company to these terms.

sections.title: 3. Your account
paragraphs: You are responsible for keeping your sign-in credentials secure and for everything that happens under your account. If you believe your account has been compromised, contact support@vercilio.ai immediately.
We may suspend or terminate accounts that breach these terms, that we reasonably believe are being used to abuse the service, or where we are required to do so by law.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable use
paragraphs: You agree not to use Vercilio to: (a) generate content that infringes someone else's rights; (b) generate sexual content involving minors; (c) build illegal weapons, malware, or instructions to harm people; (d) produce content designed to harass, threaten, or defame an identifiable person; (e) automate spam, scraping, or large-scale abuse of the service; (f) try to extract, reverse-engineer, or impersonate our underlying model providers.
We may remove content that violates these rules and we may suspend accounts responsible for repeated or serious violations.

sections.title: 5. The AI models
paragraphs: Vercilio gives you access to third-party AI models (such as those provided by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, xAI, Mistral, DeepSeek, Cohere, Perplexity, and others) through OpenRouter. These models can be wrong, can make things up, and can produce outputs you wouldn't expect. You should not rely on a model output as a substitute for professional advice (legal, medical, financial, or otherwise).

Some queries you send may be transmitted to the underlying model provider for them to generate a response. We pass them the message and any attachments you include; we do not share your billing information or your email.

sections.title: 6. Subscriptions, credits, and payments
paragraphs: Vercilio offers a free plan and paid subscriptions (Basic, Starter, Pro). Paid plans renew automatically each month until you cancel. Each plan refreshes its credit allowance at the start of every billing cycle; unused credits do not roll over. One-time credit add-ons remain available until used.

Payments are processed by Stripe, Inc. (or its EU subsidiary as applicable). By paying you also agree to Stripe's terms of service. All prices are inclusive of applicable VAT where you are billed in EUR.

You can cancel a subscription at any time from your Settings page. Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period — you keep access until then. We do not issue prorated refunds for the unused portion of a paid cycle except where required by law.

sections.title: 7. The environmental contribution
paragraphs: A portion of every paid subscription is allocated to verified reforestation work via Vercilio's partner programs (currently mangrove restoration in Brazil and Kenya and native-species planting in North America). The number of trees attributed to a payment is shown in your account.
The contribution is not a carbon offset and we make no carbon-neutrality claim. Trees are planted by our partners; we report aggregate counts based on partner reporting.

sections.title: 8. Intellectual property
paragraphs: You retain all rights to the prompts you send and the responses you generate through Vercilio (subject to the underlying model providers' own terms about output ownership). We do not use your conversations to train AI models.
Vercilio's brand, name, design, and code are our intellectual property. You may not copy or reproduce them outside of the service without our written permission.

sections.title: 9. Service availability
paragraphs: We try to keep Vercilio running 24/7 but we do not guarantee uninterrupted availability. We may make scheduled maintenance, urgent fixes, or other changes that briefly interrupt the service. We will not be liable for downtime that we did not cause through gross negligence.
We may add, remove, or modify features and model availability over time.

sections.title: 10. Disclaimer and limitation of liability
paragraphs: Vercilio is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, except where mandatory consumer protection law requires otherwise (in particular for consumers in the European Union and the United Kingdom).

To the maximum extent permitted by law, our aggregate liability to you for any claim arising out of these terms is limited to the amount you paid us in the twelve months preceding the claim. We are not liable for indirect, consequential, or special damages, including loss of profits, data, or reputation.

sections.title: 11. Termination
paragraphs: You can close your account at any time from Settings → Security → Delete account. Doing so cancels any active subscription immediately and deletes your data.
We may terminate your account if you materially breach these terms, with reasonable notice where possible.

Consumers in the European Union may also use the European Commission's Online Dispute Resolution platform at https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr/.

sections.title: 14. Contact

LegalPrivacy.metaDescription: How Vercilio collects, uses, and protects your personal data. Built around GDPR, French law, and US state privacy laws including CCPA.
LegalPrivacy.heroBody: This page explains what personal data Vercilio collects, why, who we share it with, and the rights you have over it. We've tried to keep it readable. If anything is unclear, write to privacy@vercilio.ai.

sections.title: 1. Who is the controller
paragraphs: For the purposes of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the French Data Protection Act, and the UK GDPR, Vercilio is the data controller for the personal data processed through the service.
Our contact for privacy is privacy@vercilio.ai.

sections.title: 2. What we collect
paragraphs: Account data: your email address, your name (if you choose to provide it), and your sign-in identifier from our authentication provider (Clerk).
Usage data: the chats and messages you exchange with AI models on Vercilio, the models you used, credit balances, and contribution events linked to your payments.

Billing data: when you upgrade to a paid plan, Stripe collects your payment method and billing details on our behalf. We receive an identifier and high-level metadata (plan, amount, status) but not your full card number.
Technical data: IP address, browser user agent, device type, language preference, and approximate location derived from your IP, used for security and abuse prevention.
Analytics data: aggregated usage metrics collected via Google Analytics (event counts, page views, anonymized IP).

sections.title: 3. Why we process it (legal basis)
paragraphs: Performance of contract (Art. 6.1.b GDPR): to create your account, deliver chat responses, manage your subscription, and provide the environmental contribution feature.
Legitimate interest (Art. 6.1.f GDPR): to keep the service secure, prevent abuse, debug issues, and produce aggregated product analytics. We balance our interest against your fundamental rights.
Legal obligation (Art. 6.1.c GDPR): to keep accounting records as required by French tax law (typically ten years) and to respond to lawful requests from authorities.
Consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR): for optional analytics cookies where required by local cookie law. You can withdraw consent at any time without affecting prior processing.

sections.title: 4. Who we share data with
paragraphs: We share the minimum data necessary with the following processors who act under written agreements with us:
Clerk (US) — authentication and session management.
Convex (US) — application database hosting.
Vercel (US) — application hosting and edge delivery.

OpenRouter (US) and the AI model providers it routes to (which may include OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, xAI, Mistral, DeepSeek, Cohere, Perplexity, etc.) — to generate responses to the messages you send.
Stripe (US / EU) — payment processing.
Google (US) — aggregated analytics through Google Analytics 4.
We do not sell your personal information. We do not share it with advertisers.

sections.title: 5. International transfers
paragraphs: Most of our processors are based in the United States. When personal data leaves the European Economic Area we rely on EU Standard Contractual Clauses (or an adequacy decision where one applies) to maintain a comparable level of protection.
You can ask us for a copy of the relevant safeguards by writing to privacy@vercilio.ai.

sections.title: 6. How long we keep your data
paragraphs: Account and chat data: for as long as you have an account. When you delete your account from Settings, your profile, chats, messages, contribution attributions, and credit history are removed within 30 days.
Billing and tax records: retained for 10 years from the end of the relevant accounting year, as required by French tax law. These records are minimized to the data legally necessary.
Anonymized analytics aggregates may be retained indefinitely; they cannot be linked back to you.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: Under GDPR, French data protection law, the UK GDPR, and analogous US state laws (including the California Consumer Privacy Act / CPRA), you have the right to:
Access — get a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Rectify — correct inaccurate data.
Erase — ask us to delete your data ("right to be forgotten"); you can also do this yourself from Settings → Security → Delete account.
Restrict or object — limit or object to certain processing based on legitimate interest.
Portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
Withdraw consent — where processing is based on consent, you can withdraw at any time.

California residents specifically: rights to know, delete, correct, and limit the use of sensitive personal information. We do not sell or "share" personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising as defined by the CCPA/CPRA.
To exercise any of these rights, email privacy@vercilio.ai. We will respond within 30 days.

sections.title: 8. Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: We use a small set of cookies and similar technologies. See our Cookie Policy for the specific cookies, their purpose, and how to manage them.

sections.title: 9. Security
paragraphs: We protect personal data with industry-standard measures: HTTPS for all traffic, encrypted storage with our hosting providers, narrow access for our team, secret rotation, and audit logging.
No system is perfectly secure. If we discover a breach affecting your personal data, we will notify you and the relevant supervisory authority where required by law.

sections.title: 10. Automated decision-making and profiling
paragraphs: We do not use your personal data for automated decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects on you. The AI model responses are generated by third-party providers based on the message you send; they are not personalized decisions about you.

sections.title: 11. Children
paragraphs: Vercilio is not intended for users under 16 (or the age of digital consent in your country, whichever is higher). If we learn that we have inadvertently collected personal data from a child under that age, we will delete it.

sections.title: 12. Supervisory authority
paragraphs: If you are in France, the United Kingdom, or any country in the European Economic Area, you can lodge a complaint about our processing with your local data protection authority. In France this is the CNIL (cnil.fr); in the UK this is the ICO (ico.org.uk).

sections.title: 13. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be announced by email to the address on file at least 30 days before they take effect.

sections.title: 14. Contact
paragraphs: Questions, complaints, or requests: privacy@vercilio.ai.

LegalCookies.metaDescription: What cookies Vercilio uses, why, and how you can control them. Aligned with the French ePrivacy Directive and the EU GDPR.
LegalCookies.heroBody: This page describes the cookies and similar technologies Vercilio uses, what each one does, and how you can control them. For everything else, see our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 1. What are cookies
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They are used to make sites work, remember preferences, and produce aggregate analytics.

sections.title: 2. Categories we use
paragraphs: Strictly necessary cookies (no consent required): keep you signed in and let the service function. Includes the Clerk session cookie and the CSRF protection cookie set by our hosting layer.
Functional cookies (no consent required where they only store your own preferences): remember your theme (light/dark), your language choice, and your selected AI model.

Analytics cookies (consent required where local cookie law applies): aggregated and pseudonymized measurement of which pages are visited and how the product is used. Currently provided by Google Analytics 4 with IP anonymization enabled.

sections.title: 3. Specific cookies used today
paragraphs: __session, __client (Clerk): authentication. Strictly necessary. Session-bound.

vercilio.theme, vercilio.selectedModel, vercilio.reasoningEffort, vercilio.autoRouter, vercilio.webSearch (Vercilio): user preferences. Functional. Stored in localStorage rather than HTTP cookies; you can clear them from your browser settings.

_ga, _ga_<id> (Google Analytics): aggregated analytics. 13 months. You can opt out by browser extension (tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout) or by managing the analytics consent control on this page when applicable in your jurisdiction.
__stripe_mid, __stripe_sid (Stripe): fraud prevention during checkout. Strictly necessary when you visit a payment page.

sections.title: 4. How to control cookies
paragraphs: Your browser lets you block or delete cookies (see your browser's help center). Blocking the strictly necessary cookies will stop the service from working.
In jurisdictions that require explicit consent for analytics cookies, we ask before placing them. If you change your mind, contact privacy@vercilio.ai and we will adjust your preference.

sections.title: 5. Do Not Track
paragraphs: We honor browser-level Global Privacy Control (GPC) signals as a withdrawal of analytics consent. We do not separately honor the deprecated DNT header at this time.

sections.title: 6. Updates
paragraphs: When we add or remove a cookie, we update this page. Material changes are announced alongside Privacy Policy updates.
